h1: Kuwait tourist visa from the UK
intro: Planning a holiday or a visit to family or friends in Kuwait? This page explains the Kuwait tourist visa, who needs one and what to prepare. We check the rules for your passport and apply for you.
eligibility: You are travelling for a holiday, sightseeing or to visit family or friends
You won’t work or do business during your visit
You have a return ticket and enough money for your stay
documents: Passport photo page scan, valid for at least 6 months
Hotel booking, or an invitation from the people you’re visiting

sections.heading: Do you need a Kuwait tourist visa?
sections.text: British passport holders need a visa to visit Kuwait, and can apply online for an eVisa or get one on arrival.

sections.heading: What a Kuwait tourist visa covers
sections.text: A Kuwait tourist visa is for holidays, sightseeing and visiting family or friends in Kuwait. It doesn't cover business meetings or paid work. If you're travelling for business, see our [Kuwait business visa](/kuwait-business-visa-uk/) page.

sections.heading: UK residents on other passports
sections.text: UK residents on other passports may need to apply through the Kuwaiti Embassy, depending on their nationality. Work and family visas need a sponsor in Kuwait.

sections.heading: Kuwait tourist visa help from Manchester
sections.text: We're based in Manchester city centre and handle Kuwait tourist visa applications for travellers across the UK, entirely online. Before you travel, read the UK government's [foreign travel advice](https://www.gov.uk/foreign-travel-advice) for Kuwait.

faqs.q: Can I visit family on a Kuwait tourist visa?
faqs.a: Yes. Visiting family or friends is covered by the Kuwait tourist visa.

faqs.q: Can I work in Kuwait on a Kuwait tourist visa?
faqs.a: No. Working needs a work visa or permit. Contact us and we’ll explain the options.

faqs.q: How long does a Kuwait tourist visa take?
faqs.a: Usually a few working days, but processing times vary. Apply at least a week before you travel, and earlier in busy seasons.
